lines.en: Thais, I was so glad to have been invited. The bride and I only met once, at a conference.
lines.pt: Thais, fiquei tão feliz de ter sido convidada. A noiva e eu só nos encontramos uma vez, numa conferência.

lines.en: Me too. I was surprised to have been seated at the family table, though, since I barely know the groom’s parents.
lines.pt: Eu também. Mas fiquei surpresa de ter sido colocada na mesa da família, já que mal conheço os pais do noivo.

lines.en: They seem kind. His mother told me she was thrilled to have been asked to speak after the dinner,.
lines.pt: Eles parecem gentis. A mãe dele me disse que ficou empolgada de ter sido convidada a falar depois do jantar.

lines.en: She should be proud. The flowers, the music and the cake have been planned for months, and nothing seems to have gone wrong.
lines.pt: Ela deve estar orgulhosa. As flores, a música e o bolo foram planejados por meses, e nada parece ter dado errado.

lines.en: Almost nothing. The photographer was supposed to arrive at four, and my cousin says he’s still stuck on the highway outside Denver.
lines.pt: Quase nada. O fotógrafo devia chegar às quatro, e meu primo diz que ele ainda está preso na estrada fora de Denver.

lines.en: Poor man. The bride is probably relieved to have been told in time.
lines.pt: Coitado. A noiva provavelmente está aliviada por ter sido avisada a tempo.

lines.en: Good point. If I had known, I would have brought my good camera instead of leaving it at the hotel.
lines.pt: Bom argumento. Se eu soubesse, teria trazido minha câmera boa em vez de deixá-la no hotel.

lines.en: Don’t worry. Everyone’s phone is working overtime, and the video of the first dance is already being shared online.
lines.pt: Não se preocupe. O celular de todo mundo está trabalhando dobrado e o vídeo da primeira dança já está sendo compartilhado.

lines.en: That’s the modern wedding. Honestly, I’d rather dance than film, so let’s leave the phones and join the others on the floor.
lines.pt: Esse é o casamento moderno. Sinceramente, prefiro dançar a filmar, então vamos deixar os celulares e ir para a pista.

lines.en: Deal, provided nobody expects me to dance well. I was only taught the basic steps by my grandmother years ago.
lines.pt: Combinado, desde que ninguém espere que eu dance bem. Só me ensinaram os passos básicos, minha avó, anos atrás.

lines.en: Perfect. Let me finish this drink, and we’ll be on the floor before the band plays the next song.
lines.pt: Perfeito. Deixe-me terminar esta bebida e estaremos na pista antes de a banda tocar a próxima música.

facts.label: Passivo perfeito com infinitivo
facts.sub: Use to have been + particípio para falar de algo que aconteceu com você: I was glad to have been invited.

facts.label: Passivo perfeito
facts.sub: Para falar de algo que aconteceu com você, use to have been + particípio: I was glad to have been invited. She was thrilled to have been asked. A ação veio antes do sentimento.

facts.label: Emoção
facts.sub: Antes do infinitivo vem um adjetivo de emoção: glad, thrilled, relieved, surprised, proud, upset. Eles dizem como você se sentiu por algo que lhe aconteceu.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: I was glad to have been invited is a passive structure.
We say “glad to have been invite”.
“To have been asked” looks back at a past event.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: I was glad to have been invited is a passive structure. → Verdadeiro (You were invited by someone.)
We say “glad to have been invite”. → Falso (Use the participle invited.)
“To have been asked” looks back at a past event. → Verdadeiro (The perfect infinitive looks back.)

pages.title: A busy wedding · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Saturday evening in a hall in Denver. Elena and Zoe stand near the cake. Soft music plays. Flowers cover the tables. The bride laughs with her family. The friends compare feelings.

“Zoe, I was so glad to have been invited. The bride and I only met once, at a conference.” says Elena. “Me too. I was surprised to have been seated at the family table, though, since I barely know the groom’s parents.” says Zoe. “They seem kind. His mother told me she was thrilled to have been asked to speak after the dinner,.” says Elena.
